skill.summary: Create, manage, and open time capsules — seal a thought, feeling, decision, or wish and have it delivered back to your future self with AI reflection on what...

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: seal thoughts for your future self with AI-powered 'then vs now' reflections. Features: natural language sealing, cron-based auto-delivery, 3-round memory search for context, mood-adaptive opening voice, sensitive content handling.
